components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 30rem; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #00a7d3); background: var(--paper, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #15283a); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: Literata, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.875rem; } .ds-card-lead { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--ink-soft, #3f5567); } .ds-card-rows { margin: 20px 0 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #00a7d3); } .ds-card-rows > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 6rem 1fr; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #b6e1ec); } .ds-card-rows dt { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--label, #006a85); } .ds-card-rows dd { margin: 0; } .ds-card-rows a { display: flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; color: inherit; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; } .ds-card-rows a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--rule-strong, #00a7d3); }

narrative.overview: White card stock ruled in cyan dropout ink, blue-black ballpoint text and the logo's rust as the only stamp. Every topic is a labelled field; status and contact come before story. The dark scheme is the carbon copy.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled hairlines instead of boxes and shadows
A sticky label column per field
The appointment card overlapping the portrait
Two voices: Literata for names, Atkinson Hyperlegible for reading

rules.name: The Dropout Rule
rules.body: Cyan is printed as lines, never as fills behind text.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Rust appears only where status changes what the reader should do.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Literata for names and headings, Atkinson Hyperlegible 400/700 for everything read or acted on.

rules.name: Depth by overlap
rules.body: No shadows; depth only by one sheet lying over another.

dos: Do put status and contact before story.
Do make every phone number and e-mail tappable.
Do carry state in line form plus words.
donts: Don't use shadows, gradients or glass.
Don't fill areas with cyan or rust.
Don't animate content into view on scroll.
